title: Session mesh: compact connector and consolidated backoff profiles across Py/TS/Go
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce lightweight session mesh connector and harmonize retry/backoff defaults across SDKs. Bumps Py/TS/Go SDKs (py 1.19.0, ts 2.7.0, go 1.5.2).
description: Context: Several customers and internal workloads showed noisy reconnects and variable tail latency for long-lived streaming sessions. Investigation (ENG-1249) found duplicated heartbeat/lease logic across SDKs and divergent backoff defaults that caused retry storms under transient infra flakiness. This PR introduces a compact session mesh connector that centralizes session priming and a shared backoff profile bundle to harmonize defaults across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Goals: reduce redundant handshakes, smooth retry windows, and provide an ergonomic opt-in for session prefetching. Work included: - compact connector implementation in each SDK with identical surface (connect(), primeSession(), drain()) - shared JSON backoff profile shipped as a single source-of-truth used by SDKs and the session proxy - small runtime optimization in the session mesh routing logic to avoid duplicate heartbeats for co-located streams - tests and e2e scenarios exercising long-lived stream stability - documentation and CHANGELOG entries for each SDK Note: this is a cross-repo change: core redwood runtime + redwood-sdk-python + redwood-sdk-typescript + redwood-sdk-go. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-1249) [x] unit tests added/updated [x] integration e2e (local) smoke run [x] CLI docs updated [x] release notes drafted Implementation summary: Commits: See commit list below. Compatibility: default backoff semantics changed to a slightly less aggressive window (max_backoff reduced from 45s to 22s for the default profile). This is conservative and opt-out by providing per-client overrides. Upgrade guidance: SDKs are backward-compatible; consumers who relied on very aggressive reconnect behaviour should pin the old profile or configure custom backoff. Metrics: added session.mesh.heartbeat_reductions and session.mesh.prefetch_hits to instrumentation; dashboards updated (observability PR coming).
